summary: Theravance Biopharma filed an 8-K updating its pending merger with Zymeworks Inc. under a June 28, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger, whereby a Zymeworks Cayman merger subsidiary will merge into Theravance, leaving Theravance a wholly owned Zymeworks subsidiary. A definitive proxy statement was filed August 21, 2026, with the extraordinary general meeting set for September 18, 2026. Three shareholder complaints and thirteen demand letters allege proxy disclosure deficiencies and seek injunction, rescission, or damages. Theravance denies all allegations. Watch the September 18 vote and any mootness-based supplemental disclosure that could delay closing.
